[[Calissa Sedgwick]] is a [[collector]] of [[Charr Hide]]s, the only salvage item in the game that can be traded to a collector.

==Locations==
*[[Ascalon]]
**{{NPC location|Ascalon City}} (in Merchant's Row)

==Dialogue==
:''"I'm searching for 4 [[Charr Hide]]s. I can offer you one of the following [[item]]s in exchange. Can you help me?"''

==Collector items==
{{:Calissa Sedgwick/Collector}}

== Notes ==
{{Anomaly|As noted, she is the only permanent collector in the game who collects salvage items instead of trophies.}}

== Trivia ==
* Calissa Sedgwick was added to the game in 2005 in response to the high market costs of fur, which had risen to around {{cost|2000}}.
